texto.muro: a wall of raw board-formed concrete with the grain of the planks still printed in it

escena: SCENE (a review with the client, meeting room in Santiago, morning): she wears the Efeonce team softshell jacket with the Efeonce lanyard — the high register, an important meeting. The camera takes THE CLIENT'S PLACE at the table: it sits at seated eye level, she is on the far side facing it, and she addresses that place — she looks at the work between them, never into the lens. The nearest edge of the viewer's own chair enters at the bottom. She sits LOW in the frame; the reserved concrete wall above her stays in even shadow with nothing crossing it. An AZURE-BLUE screen on the side wall lights her jaw. Caught AT THE INSTANT she turns a printed sheet towards the empty chair. 50mm at f/2. Everything is completely unbranded beyond the Efeonce garments.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the viewer's own chair back, right against the lens, unlit
